name: NRA CET Common Eligibility Practice Mock - Practice Test 2
courseName: NRA CET Common Eligibility Practice Mock

questions.question: Who is the head of the National Recruitment Agency (NRA) governing body?
questions.hint: NRA is headed by a Chairman of the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.

questions.question: NRA CET will replace preliminary exams for which organizations?
questions.hint: CET replaces Tier-1 screening for banking, railways, and clerical posts.

questions.question: Which article of the Constitution relates to the Finance Commission?
questions.hint: Article 280 requires the President to set up a Finance Commission every 5 years.

questions.question: The first railway line in India was opened in:
questions.hint: The line between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane opened on 16 April 1853.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.hint: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.

questions.question: Which river is also known as the Dakshin Ganga?
questions.hint: Godavari is the second longest river in India and largest in south India.

questions.question: The simple interest on Rs 5000 for 2 years at 10% per annum is:
In a family tree, your father's sister is your:
questions.hint: Paternal sister is commonly referred to as aunt.

questions.question: Which of the following is a synonym of Benevolent?
questions.hint: Benevolent means well-meaning, generous, and kindly.

questions.question: The standard units digit of (256)^78 is:
questions.hint: Any power of a number ending in 6 will always have a units digit of 6.

questions.question: Which gland in human body is called the master gland?
questions.hint: Pituitary gland controls functions of many other endocrine glands.

questions.question: The Indian standard time (IST) is based on the longitude of:
questions.hint: IST passes through Mirzapur, UP along the 82°30' E line.

questions.question: Who wrote the national anthem of India?
questions.hint: Jana Gana Mana was originally composed in Bengali by Tagore.

questions.question: The power to create new states in India rests with:
questions.hint: Article 3 empowers Parliament to form new states or alter boundaries.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of water?
questions.hint: Water molecules comprise two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
